newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian truckers to stage nationwide strike.
newsitem.headline: Colombian truckers to stage nationwide strike.

text.p: Colombian truck drivers will begin a nationwide strike next week to press for higher official tariffs and the lifting of a restriction on older vehicles, a union official said.
Luz Mari Tangarife, executive director of the Colombian Truckers Association, said the strike would begin Monday and hamper all shipments to the nation's ports, including coffee and coal.
"The immobilization will be total and for an indefinite time period," Tangarife said in a telephone interview.
In addition to higher tariffs, she said the strike had been called to press for the lifting of a recent ban on transport vehicles that are more than 16 years old.
Tangarife said at least 120,000 trucks would be kept off Colombia's highways by the strike.
The work stoppage is not supported by the larger Colombian Federation of Highway Cargo Transporters (Colfecar), however, and it may prove to be only partially successful.
Monday is a national holiday in Colombia and industry sources said the effectiveness of the job action probably would not be apparent until Tuesday.
